windowBasis: [I] Candidate review envelope, not an incident trigger, publication date or proof of receipt. A named act still needs its own source/date. Inherited windows are byte-for-byte unchanged.

facets.recommendation: [I] Carry required founding/slavery-status clauses and nonzero agency contributions for any applicable verdict; distinguish the observed end State from predictions about peace.

agencyReasonNotes: [I] No class-required agency reason. Preserve named actors in reports; do not invent a derived mechanic or use absence of a reason as permission to target people.

triggerRules.policy: [I] Whole-word rules from triggerMatches; use the live proper-noun allowlist as well. A match requests review, never assigns a topic automatically. No gate:none approval is supplied.

topicRules: No virtue score, sole presidential credit or prediction about a winner’s future government. January 1863 policy cannot be described as already implemented in September.

examples.allowedOnlyAsWordingExample: The account states the policy in force and people’s actions at the end.
examples.rejectExample: The player’s noble policy guaranteed freedom after the war.

remaining: R5/required-clause ids and new primary founding quotations remain for later review; no verdict strings authored here.
